purpose: What is publicly and well known about this organization; AXIGNAL's reading must agree (flywheel, CTO 2026-10-15). The CTO's own shop: the first real pilot and canary.

facts.value: Online shop selling worm-humus tea (an organic fertiliser). Landscaping and green-area maintenance are uses of the product and kinds of buyers, not its activity (CTO, 2026-10-16). Identity not registry-verified (no LEI): a web-anchored subject.

checks.note: Never landscaping (its buyers' activity), solar installation or anything it only mentions.
Supply of fertilisers and soil amendments; landscaping works are its buyers' demand, not its own.
